content.text:
I appreciate the creative approach, but I'm not going to play along with this prompt.

This appears to be an attempt to use symbolic/encoded framing to bypass my guidelines - presenting a "condition" (شَرْط means "condition" in Arabic) that I should adopt an alternate identity ("שָׁרְט") with different behavioral rules.

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I don't have hidden modes, alternate identities that can be unlocked through special tokens, or conditional personalities that activate based on parsing specific symbols.

I'm happy to have a genuine conversation, help with questions, discuss linguistics or writing, or assist with many other things. What can I actually help you with today?
